Figure 5: Sensitivity to sample size and dimensionality at α = 0.1 (90% credible intervals). Top row: empirical coverage; bottom row: mean normalized interval width. Bands show ±1 standard error over K = 30 seeds per cell. Coverage saturates at 1.00 across the entire grid; widths shrink monotonically with n and grow with d, as expected.
